meta.engine_seeds: oracle: the majority over the 32 oracle seeds above; residual seeds (pools and surrogates only, disjoint from the oracle's): primary seed_for('task', start, task, H), secondary seed_for('task-secondary', start, task, H, k), k=0..7
meta.residual_definition: truth seeds seed_for('task-truth', start, forced key, H, k), k < 64, shared by the tasks of a start, disjoint from every residual and oracle seed; residual of a pool plan = judge score minus its mean margin over all 64; the surrogate selects on a pool plan's mean over truth seeds 0..31 (a cross-entropy candidate's over 0..15) plus a drawn search residual and accepts on the selected plan's mean over 32..63 plus the paired verdict residual; the floor's selected plan is judged by the majority oracle; the nine old seeds are not used by the floor; residual draw 'volatility': the candidate's paired residual is drawn uniformly from the 100 pool plans nearest in log(s + 0.001), s = the sample standard deviation of the margin over all 64 truth seeds (pool plans) or over the candidate's search-truth seeds; ties by pool order; a pool without spread in s draws uniformly
meta.flip_floor: flip surrogate and flip_closed_form_family_rates use confusion rates pooled within the task family and the per-instance base rate; the instrument's built-in flip_closed_form pools confusion rates over every behaviour plan
